# Kaamless

> Automation built to order for companies and institutes around Dombivli, Thane and Navi Mumbai.
> One process at a time, a fixed price per job, built on the client's own systems and handed over
> with the code. Run by one DevOps engineer, not an agency.

Not a product or a platform. There is no subscription for software. The engagement is: a paid
audit that says what is worth automating (and what is not), then a fixed price per build, then an
optional monthly plan if the client would rather not maintain it themselves.

## What gets automated

- [Reports that build themselves](/automations/reports): the weekly or monthly report somebody assembles by hand from several sources.
- [Data moving between systems](/automations/integration): export-then-import rituals, records typed into two places, daily files that arrive by email.
- [Documents and paperwork](/automations/documents): invoices, receipts, certificates and ID cards generated from a record, numbered in sequence.
- [Spreadsheets and back-office](/automations/spreadsheets): reconciliation done by eye, monthly cleaning, consolidating branch files, a workbook only one person understands.
- [Deployments, environments and releases](/automations/deployments): CI/CD pipelines, environments as code, tested rollbacks, secrets management, rehearsed restores.
- [Cloud cost and housekeeping](/automations/cloud): cost breakdowns, shutting down non-production out of hours, tagging, expiry alerts, orphaned resources.
- [Monitoring, alerts and on-call](/automations/monitoring): external health checks, alert de-duplication and routing, status pages, incident timelines.
- [Joining, moving and leaving](/automations/people): onboarding and offboarding across many tools, access reviews, asset tracking.
- [Approvals and internal requests](/automations/requests): approval routing, escalation when someone is on leave, visible status, expense chasing.
- [Schools, colleges and coaching institutes](/automations/institutes): fee dues and receipts, attendance, marks and report cards, parent updates.

## Pricing

- Automation audit: Rs 9,999, credited in full against the first build
- Quick win: Rs 18,000 to Rs 45,000, ready in 3 to 7 working days
- Connected module: Rs 60,000 to Rs 1,80,000, two to four weeks
- System: from Rs 2,50,000, staged
- Care plans: Rs 4,999 / Rs 9,999 / Rs 19,999 per month, optional
- Day rate: Rs 12,000
- Payment: half to start, half one week after it runs on real data

## Key pages

- [See an automation run](/demo): a working pipeline that cleans deliberately messy branch files in the browser. Not a recording.
- [What a manual job costs](/calculator): hours, people and loaded cost in; yearly cost and payback period out. Runs entirely in the browser.
- [How it works](/how-it-works): the five steps, what the audit involves, and what handover means.
- [Pricing](/pricing): every number above, in full.
- [Who it's for](/who-its-for): companies with more process than people, engineering teams with no DevOps, MIDC manufacturing, agencies, institutes — and who it is not for.

## What will not be built, at any price

Anything that pretends to be a person. Bulk messaging through unofficial WhatsApp tools. Scraping
other organisations' customer or student data. Automation designed to make people redundant
quietly. Any system only the builder can maintain — everything is handed over with the code, the
credentials and written notes.

## Service area

Based in Dombivli, Maharashtra. On site across Dombivli, Kalyan, Thane, Navi Mumbai, Ulhasnagar,
Ambernath and Badlapur, including the MIDC estates and the offices at Wagle Estate, Airoli and
Mahape. Remote beyond that.
